exposure: Uterine artery embolization and ultrasound guided curettage
Uterine artery embolization plus methotrexate and ultrasound guided curettage
outcome: Immediate therapeutic outcomes (e.g., gestational sac elimination)
Days to recover to normal b-HCG
Subsequent fertility effects (reproductive desire, conception success, recurrent cesarean scar pregnancy)
cohort: The study included 82 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy.
finding: Uterine artery embolization combined with or without methotrexate plus ultrasound guided curettage effectively and safely eliminates gestational sacs and preserves fertility in cesarean scar pregnancy patients, with methotrexate specifically reducing b-HCG levels and hospital stay.
